name: MSFT Return Decomposition: Earnings Growth, Multiple Expansion & Rate Sensitivity
description: Decomposes MSFT's last 12 months of daily price returns into two fundamental drivers — EPS earnings growth and P/E multiple expansion — and measures rate sensitivity against the 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10). Shows cumulative contribution of each component over time, rolling 60-day beta to real yield changes, and a scatter of daily returns vs yield moves.
source:
# =============================================================================
# MSFT RETURN DECOMPOSITION: EARNINGS GROWTH · MULTIPLE EXPANSION · RATE SENSITIVITY
# =============================================================================
# Research Question: How much of MSFT's last 12 months of price return came from
# earnings growth vs. P/E multiple expansion? And how sensitive is MSFT to moves
# in real interest rates (10-yr TIPS yield)?
#
# Decomposition Identity:
#   Total Return ≈ EPS Growth Contribution + P/E Expansion Contribution + residual
#   where:
#     eps_growth_contrib  = (EPS_t - EPS_0) / Price_0     (earnings per unit of base price)
#     pe_expansion_contrib = Total Return - eps_growth_contrib
#
# Rate Sensitivity:
#   Rolling 60-day beta = Cov(MSFT daily ret, Δyield) / Var(Δyield)
# =============================================================================

# --- Price Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Earnings: quarterly EPS, forward-filled to daily ---
earn = earnings(period=EarningsPeriod.quarterly)()
actual_eps = earn.actual_eps
# Forward-fill sparse quarterly EPS to every trading day
daily_eps = ffill(actual_eps)

# --- 10-Year TIPS Real Yield (DFII10) from FRED, forward-filled ---
tips = economic_indicators(series_id='DFII10', use_alfred=False)()
real_yield_raw = tips.result
real_yield = ffill(real_yield_raw)

# =============================================================================
# DAILY RETURNS & YIELD CHANGES
# =============================================================================

daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)

# Daily change in real yield (in percentage points)
yield_chg = real_yield - (real_yield >> 1)

# =============================================================================
# RETURN DECOMPOSITION (DAILY ATTRIBUTION, CUMULATED)
# =============================================================================
# Each day's return is split into:
#   EPS component  = ΔEPS / P(t-1)   [how much the earnings change moved price]
#   P/E component  = daily_ret - EPS component  [the multiple re-rating residual]
# Summing these daily increments gives the full-period attribution.

price_prev = close >> 1
eps_prev   = daily_eps >> 1

# Daily EPS contribution: earnings change normalized by yesterday's price
daily_eps_component = where(
    is_valid(eps_prev) and (eps_prev > 0),
    (daily_eps - eps_prev) / price_prev,
    0.0
)

# Daily P/E expansion: residual after removing EPS attribution
daily_pe_component = daily_ret - daily_eps_component

# --- Current P/E and P/E ~12 months ago ---
pe_current = close / daily_eps
pe_12m_ago = (close >> 251) / (daily_eps >> 251)

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING 60-DAY BETA TO REAL YIELD CHANGES
# =============================================================================

cov_msft_yield  = rolling_cov(window=60)(daily_ret, yield_chg)
var_yield       = var(period=60)(yield_chg)
rolling_beta_60 = cov_msft_yield.result / var_yield.result

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE COMPONENTS (for timeseries chart)
# =============================================================================

cum_total_ret    = cumulative()(daily_ret)
cum_eps_growth   = cumulative()(daily_eps_component)
cum_pe_expansion = cumulative()(daily_pe_component)

# Timestamp index for xy_lines
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — CATEGORY 1: OVERVIEW CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='MSFT 12-Month Return Decomposition',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Total 12M Price Return', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='EPS Growth Contribution', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(title='P/E Multiple Expansion', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_color=Color.Orange),
            ColumnSpec(title='Current P/E Ratio', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='P/E 12M Ago', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, card_color=Color.Muted),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rolling 60D Beta to Real Yield', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Overview'
)(cum_total_ret, cum_eps_growth, cum_pe_expansion, pe_current, pe_12m_ago, rolling_beta_60)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — CATEGORY 2: CUMULATIVE RETURN DECOMPOSITION TIMESERIES
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return Decomposition: Total vs EPS Growth vs P/E Expansion',
    category='2. Return Decomposition',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Date',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Total Price Return', color=Color.Black),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EPS Growth Contribution', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='P/E Multiple Expansion', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(bar_ts, cum_total_ret, cum_eps_growth, cum_pe_expansion)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — CATEGORY 3: REAL YIELD TIMESERIES
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='10-Year TIPS Real Yield (DFII10) — Last 12 Months',
    category='3. Real Yield',
    y_axis_label='Real Yield (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Date',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y TIPS Real Yield', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(bar_ts, real_yield)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — CATEGORY 4: SCATTER — MSFT DAILY RETURNS vs REAL YIELD CHANGES
# =============================================================================

xy_scatter(
    title='MSFT Daily Returns vs 10Y Real Yield Changes',
    category='4. Rate Sensitivity Scatter',
    x_axis_label='Daily Change in 10Y Real Yield (pp)',
    y_axis_label='MSFT Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Obs', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ])
)(yield_chg, daily_ret)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — CATEGORY 5: ROLLING 60-DAY BETA TO REAL YIELD
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Beta of MSFT to 10Y Real Yield Changes',
    category='5. Rolling Beta',
    y_axis_label='Beta (MSFT ret / yield chg)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Date',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rolling 60D Beta', color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(bar_ts, rolling_beta_60)
